description: AOL Video has been redesigned! Watch the latest videos in News, Weather, Finance, Entertainment and Lifestyle on AOL Video! Our library includes video content from: NBC, ABC, Reuters, WSJ, TMZ, Entertainment Tonight, Engadget, TechCrunch, CNET, Buzzfeed, AOL Originals, Fox Sports, and Discovery, just to name a few.
